acceptance_criteria.given: Day 2 accommodation board card is rendered with draggable='true' (confirmed by prior cycle 20260524-180339 AC1) and the CandidatesSidebar (#candidates-groups) drop zone is visible in the page
acceptance_criteria.when: Playwright executes a drag from the accommodation board card ([data-slot-card='primary'][data-slot-id='accommodation']) to the #candidates-groups element
acceptance_criteria.then: /api/save receives a POST request whose JSON body contains an element matching {type:'select', slot:'accommodation', option_id:null} AND the accommodation slot on the board subsequently renders without the green selection ring (no '0 0 0 2px #45b26b' box-shadow or equivalent selected-state indicator)

acceptance_criteria.then: /api/save receives a POST request whose JSON body contains an element matching {type:'select', slot:'accommodation', option_id:<non-null string>} where option_id matches the dragged candidate's data-option-id attribute AND the board renders that candidate as the selected card

check.setup: page.route('/api/save', handler) to capture POST body before drag; capture data-option-id from the sidebar candidate card before drag

acceptance_criteria.given: A candidate card in CandidatesSidebar where isPending is true — i.e., the user has clicked the card once to enter pending selection state (pendingSelection.optionId matches the card's option_id)
